Launch the Atlas point-and-click app

Source: R/app.R
atlas_app.Rd

A browser UI for people who don't write R: upload a CSV, choose what to predict, optionally describe goals and rules in plain English, and click Build. Progress streams live; when the agent needs a decision, a dialog pops up. Results (leaderboard, constraint compliance, report, and the full R code) appear when the build finishes, and everything is also saved to the run directory as usual.

Usage

atlas_app(max_upload_mb = 500)

Arguments

max_upload_mb

Maximum size of an uploaded CSV, in megabytes. (Shiny's own default is a stingy 5 MB.)

Value

Called for its side effect (runs the app until you close it).

Details

The build runs in a background R process (via callr), so the app stays responsive; the agent's questions travel through small files in the run directory. Requires the shiny and callr packages and an API key for your LLM provider (see vignette("atlas")).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
atlas_app()
atlas_app(max_upload_mb = 2000)  # roomier limit for big files
} # }
